title: Whole Domed Coarse-Band Low-Entry Skep
description: One newly authored complete static coarse-band straw-skep-like hive cover. A continuous thick rounded dome encloses a genuine uninterrupted hollow interior and has a whole open underside. A low front arched entrance is part of the real wall boundary with full thick jamb and lintel surfaces, not a black decal or overlapping door block. Broad circumferential ridges are geometric surface relief integrated into the same shell, with quieter inner walls and a closed finite-thickness crown. The new low mouth, closed dome, bottom aperture and full roof-to-wall continuity differ from the old raised stacked timber supers and the old open-top floored carrying basket. No old basket is inverted or imported, no merely additional coil count defines the object. One model zero scenes. Opaque static decorative/historical-style game prop, not real woven fibres or a living colony installation. No bee habitat, ventilation, brood chamber, harvesting, thermal, strength, carrying, animal care or operating safety claim.
